chemsys.definition: element set = sorted distinct elements of the host formula (pymatgen Composition of data/universe_v1_ids.csv formula); a test site is absent when no host of that resample's training pool (the 654 non-test hosts) has the same element set

concentration.definition: site appearance = (resample, test site) over the 30 resamples; d = |e_S| - |e_X| of the seed ensembles (positive = X more accurate); pooled = mean of d over all appearances; contribution of a host = sum of d over its appearances / number of all appearances; shares = sum of the largest contributions / pooled; fraction of hosts uses the host mean of d over its appearances; trimmed mean cuts 10 % of appearances at each end (scipy.stats.trim_mean); intervals: host-cluster bootstrap over the distinct test hosts, HierDraws.make([n_hosts], 2000, 20261008), multiplicity of a drawn host applied to all its appearances (median and trimmed mean of the expanded sample)
concentration.note: the pooled mean weights resamples by their site count and so differs slightly from the paper estimator (mean over resamples of the per-resample MAE)

payload.design: 654 training hosts, outer resamples r = 0-29 x seeds 0-4; S and D from results/analysis/precision_eval_long.parquet (v2, B = 654); D* from results/dretrain_v2 (D-late, configs/tuned_d_v2.yaml)
payload.estimator: seed-ensemble mean prediction per (model, r, site); per resample the site MAE over the subset's test sites; point = mean over resamples with at least one subset site; intervals on HierDraws.make([164] * 30, 2000, 20261008) with the subset applied as a site filter inside each drawn resample slot (bootstrap host multiplicities kept, slot MAE over the subset sites of the drawn hosts, empty slots left out of the replicate mean); ci95 = 2.5/97.5 percentiles; upper_one_sided_95 (U) = 95th percentile; all gaps paired on the same draws

high_moment.definition: test-side exclusion: the listed sites are removed from every test set of the headline design (no retraining); hosts keep their other sites; change = excluded - all, paired per replicate on the headline draws
high_moment.source_record: results/derived_n4/high_moment_final_network.json (threshold 0.5 muB; that record retrains S and D without the entries on the 10 x 3 design and reports A)

payload.label: subset sensitivity of A* = MAE_S - MAE_D* and A = MAE_S - MAE_D on the headline design (654 hosts, 30 x 5): tuning hosts, concentration over hosts, chemical-system siblings, high-moment entries; family-cluster bootstrap of the leave-family-out A

loco_family.design: splits/loco_v1.json: 131 host families (S02 definition ii-a) in 5 GroupKFold folds; each fold's S and D-state trained without its families (results/loco_v2, seeds 0-2, seed-ensemble mean); pooled out-of-fold site MAE over 1726 sites; A = MAE_S - MAE_D (D* was not run on this design)

family_bootstrap.construction: HierDraws.make([131], 2000, 20261008): families with replacement, all sites of a drawn family

host_bootstrap.construction: HierDraws.make([818], 2000, 20261008): hosts with replacement, all sites of a drawn host

reproduction.reference: results/derived_c1/loco_family.json payload.v2.pooled (A, ci95, upper_one_sided_95; host bootstrap)

headline_all_sites.reference: results/derived_dstar/dstar_gaps.json payload.headline_654_30x5.654 (MAE of S, D, D* with ci95; S - D* and S - D: A, ci95, upper_one_sided_95, per_resample)

loco_family.pooled_host_bootstrap.reference: results/derived_c1/loco_family.json payload.v2.pooled (A, ci95, upper_one_sided_95; host bootstrap)

sign_convention.S_minus_D: A = MAE_S - MAE_D (positive = D more accurate)
sign_convention.S_minus_Dstar: A* = MAE_S - MAE_D* (positive = D* more accurate)
sign_convention.change: subset value minus all-site value, paired on the same draws
sign_convention.d: |e_S| - |e_X| per site appearance (positive = X more accurate)

tuning_hosts.construction: tuning resample r = 0, anchor 654 hosts: training pool = budget_train(outer_r0, 654) (all 654 non-test hosts of resample 0); validation hosts = val_split(pool, frac 0.1, min_hosts 3, seed val_seed(0, 654, 0)); tuning set = pool = training + validation hosts. The 654-anchor studies of S, D-state, D-late, P1 (tuned_v2) and the D* study (v2_D_a654) all record these host and site counts

overlap.definition: fraction of a resample's 164 test hosts inside the 654-host tuning set

resample_0_vs_rest.note: resample 0 is the tuning resample: none of its test hosts entered tuning; the interval is a host bootstrap within resample 0 (HierDraws.make([164], 2000, 20261008))

validation_hosts_only_random_reference.population: the 654 hosts of resample 0's training pool (the population the validation hosts were drawn from); subsets drawn without replacement with numpy default_rng(20261008).choice
